description: Add, remove, disable, or enable a firewall rule on a MikroTik router. Uses comment as idempotency key for deduplication and identification. Supports dry-run mode.

action.description: Action to perform: add, remove, disable, or enable a firewall rule

chain.description: Firewall chain (e.g. forward, input, output, srcnat, dstnat)

comment.description: Comment to identify the rule (used as idempotency key)

confirmationToken.description: Token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Re-submit the identical call with this token to confirm the destructive action.

disabled.description: Whether the rule should be disabled

dryRun.description: If true, validate and return planned changes without applying

placeBefore.description: Place the new rule before this rule ID

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

ruleAction.description: RouterOS rule action (e.g. accept, drop, reject, masquerade)

table.description: Firewall table to manage: filter or nat

name: manage_firewall_rule
title: Manage Firewall Rule
